why_two_copies: Light Path Is-Camera-Ray split: lighting rays sample the 4K copy (small importance map, low noise), camera rays see the 16K copy. At 52mm the visible slice is 16384*38.19/360 = 1738 px, i.e. 91% of the plate real 1920 px of detail.
